title: Conference Reservation
subject: listening

paragraphs.text: Section 1
CLERK: Conference Centre Reservations. Good morning.
WOMAN: Hi. I'm interested in the computing conference next month.
CLERK: Future Directions in Computing?
WOMAN: Yes, that's right. Could I ask you a few questions about it?
CLERK: Of course.
WOMAN: OK. I know the conference is for three days but actually I want to attend on the Friday and Saturday only. Will that work out to be any cheaper?

CLERK: Let me have a look. Well, you could register for the two days separately, but that wouldn't actually save you very much as it still costs £35 for each day. In fact, if you could register for the three days, you also get an invitation to a free dinner on the Saturday night, so that's probably the better option.
WOMAN: Right, I'll do that. How much will the fees be in that case?
CLERK: It's £75.
WOMAN: All right. I'd like to register for the full three days. Now, can I pay that by credit card?
CLERK: I'm afraid not. You'll have to send a cheque to us, or you can pay at the conference office.
WOMAN: Fine. So it's probably easiest if I pay by cheque. Now then, what else do I need to arrange?
Right. How about accommodation? I guess that's not included in the price?

CLERK: No, I'm sorry, it's not, but we do have a few rooms available for delegates at the conference centre if you'd like. Those are very cheap but if you're interested you'll need to book soon, because there's always a heavy demand for them. They are only £15 per night, but they are very basic and you'd have to get your own breakfast, because they don't provide you with that. But it's very convenient, because it's in the same building as the conference rooms.
WOMAN: Uhuh.
CLERK: Or there's a very reasonable guest house which is £25 per night. And I think that includes your breakfast.
WOMAN: Is it close to the conference centre?
CLERK: It would be about a ten-minute walk away from here.
WOMAN: I see. That sounds quite reasonable.
CLERK: The details are all in our conference pack, which I'll send you.
WOMAN: Great, thanks. That'll be very useful. Oh, and can you also send me an application form?
CLERK: Of course. I'll get that in the post to you straight away. Is there anything else?
WOMAN: Yes, actually. Can you tell me where exactly the conference centre is?

CLERK: Well, it's on South Park Road and it's right at the end of the road next to the library. It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will cost you £5. Otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every half an hour from the station - that's the 21A - and it brings you straight to the conference centre.
WOMAN: Right, got that.
CLERK：会议中心预订。早上好。
WOMAN：你好。我对下个月的计算机会议感兴趣。
CLERK：未来的计算方向？
WOMAN：是的，正确。我可以问你几个问题吗？
CLERK：当然。
WOMAN：好的。我知道这次会议是三天，但实际上我想参加星期五和星期六的会议。
会不会有更便宜的？
CLERK：让我看看。嗯，你可以分别注册为两天，但实际上你仍然需要成本￡35的每天。事实上，如果你可以注册三天，你还会得到一个星期六晚上的免费的晚餐邀请，所以这可能是更好的选择。
WOMAN：对，我会那样做的。在这种情况下的费用是多少？
CLERK：是￡75。
WOMAN：好的。我想注册三天。现在，我可以用信用卡付款吗？
CLERK：恐怕不能。你得给我们开一张支票，否则你可以需要在会议室付钱。
WOMAN：好的。所以如果我用支票支付可能是最容易的。现在，我还需要安排什么呢？好的，住宿如何？我想这是不包括在价格之内的？
CLERK：不，对不起，不是，但是如果你愿意的话，我们有几个提供给会议中心代表的房间。这些都很便宜，但如果你感兴趣的话，你很快就要预订，因为他们对他们的需求总是很重。他们只需要每晚￡15，但他们都是很基本的，你要有你自己的早餐，因为他们不提供给你。但它很方便，因为它和会议室在同一个建筑中。
WOMAN：嗯。
CLERK：或者有一个非常价格合理的宾客屋酒店，每晚￡25。我认为这包含了你的早餐。
WOMAN：靠近会议中心吗？
CLERK：这将是大约需要10分钟从这里走过去。
WOMAN：我明白了。那听起来很合理。
CLERK：细节都在我们的会议包里，我会给你寄的。
WOMAN：很好，谢谢。那将是非常有用的。哦，你还可以给我发一份申请表吗？
CLERK：当然。我会直接寄给你。还有别的吗？
WOMAN：是的，实际上。你能告诉我会议中心在哪里吗？
CLERK：好的，它在南公园路，就在在图书馆旁边的路的尽头。从车站乘出租车过去会用10分钟时间，花费你￡5。否则，你可以乘坐每半小时从车站的公共汽车21A-它将直接去会议中心。
WOMAN：好的，知道了。
